item.title: Solved: How to Pass Parameters to a Fixture Function in Pytest
item.description:
In the realm of Python testing, especially with the powerful Pytest framework, passing parameters to fixture functions can streamline your testing strategy immensely. When dealing with complex applications—say, for instance, utilizing DLLs wrapped in Python classes—it’s crucial to validate numerous test scenarios without repetitive code.

The Challenge

Consider a scenario where you are testing a class, MyTester, that interfaces with various function calls and variables from a DLL. You face a challenge: how can you efficiently pass a list of these DLL variables to your fixture so all your test files can utilize the same testing context?
